plaatsen.tekst: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule
Is this man Coniah a despised broken idol? is he a vessel wherein is no pleasure? wherefore are they cast out, he and his seed, and are cast into a land which they know
Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours be in the house of a stranger;
In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.
